_comment: Factory routines (issue #117): recurring activities run on a schedule, one mechanism, one file. Validated on load; unknown keys and bad values fail. kind check = a deterministic harness command (no model, GITHUB_TOKEN only); kind agent = a read-only CodeAF run with a brief from routines/, capped by max_usd, filing codeaf-proposed issues only. Cooldowns are the number of hours after the routine's last run before it is due again.
